title: Youth Rally at Terra Sancta
description:
Sunday, October 11th, 2026 | Grades 6-12 | 9am – 4pm
Check in begins at 8:30am at Holy Cross Chapel at Terra Sancta Retreat Center

Cost: $65 includes registration and lunch. Optional traveler’s meal available. 

Early bird discount if registered by Sept. 11.

Please reach out to Sr. Sara, SCTJM with any questions: skowal@diorc.org

The registration deadline is October 4!

Hosted by the Diocese of Rapid City Office of Youth and Young Adult Ministry.

Register here at this link: https://rapidcitydiocese.ccbchurch.com/goto/forms/450/responses/new
